verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a natural-language assistant, Azure Copilot, but only as a one-line mention of generating Terraform configurations. An official MCP server also lets AI clients drive Azure through conversational prompts, though only indirectly through a third-party agent. There is no first-party evidence of directly operating or managing resources with natural-language commands. Missing for 10: documented natural-language operation of resources (create, modify, troubleshoot) beyond Terraform generation, depth on Copilot's scope and limits, hands-on or independent corroboration.
